title: Define Value Pillars (3–5) grounded in DaemonCore V1 guarantees
description: Define 3–5 value pillars (e.g. Trust & Predictability, Risk Containment, Auditability & Accountability, Compliance Readiness, Vendor Independence). For each: the problem it solves, why current approaches plateau, and which DaemonCore V1 mechanisms support it.
acceptance_criteria: 3–5 value pillars are defined in executive-readable language.
Each pillar explicitly maps to at least one DaemonCore V1 guarantee/mechanism.
No hype, no vague promises, no V1.5-as-current claims.
